question: The target of the aminoglycoside antibacterials is the:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Aminoglycoside antibacterials -> bind to the 30S subunit of the ribosome -> disrupt protein synthesis -> inhibit bacterial growth -> 95% CHAIN: Aminoglycoside antibacterials -> target the 30S subunit of the ribosome -> cause misreading of mRNA -> lead to production of faulty proteins -> 95%
analysis: Aminoglycoside antibacterials target the 30S subunit of the ribosome in bacteria, leading to inhibition of protein synthesis.
